questions.definition: A person who travels by air for business purposes frequently is known as a **frequent flyer**

A person who is very good at solving problems quickly and efficiently is described as being **resourceful**
When something is **outdated**, it means it is no longer relevant or in use due to being old-fashioned or obsolete
